paragraphs.text: All staff must wear the green company shirt, which is provided free, together with their own dark trousers and closed shoes. Name badges should be collected from the office on your first morning.

Breaks are taken on a rota. For a full day shift you are entitled to a 45-minute lunch break and a 15-minute break in the afternoon. Please check the rota on the staff noticeboard at the start of each week.
Staff receive a 25% discount on plants and garden tools, but this does not apply to items in the café or to gift vouchers.
If you are unable to come to work because of illness, phone your supervisor before 8 am. Text messages and emails are not accepted.

Staff parking is available behind the greenhouses. Please do not park in the customer car park, which is often full at weekends. Lockers for personal belongings are in the staff room next to the office.
